newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria 1995 trade deficit narrows 29.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austria 1995 trade deficit narrows 29.8 pct.

text.p: Austria's trade deficit narrowed to 81.7 billion schillings in 1995 from 116.4 billion in 1994, the central statistics office said on Thursday.
Exports rose 12.5 percent to 576.7 billion schillings, while imports climbed 4.7 percent to 658.4 billion schillings.
The statistics office said the figures were provisional.
The office said 72.5 percent of imports and 65.5 percent of exports were linked to trade with members of the European Union.
Austria's most significant trading partners remain Germany, followed by Italy, France and the Netherlands.
Among non-EU countries, Austria's main trading partners were Switzerland, the U.S. and central and eastern European countries. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
